definition.interpretation: The experiment returned an inconclusive result regarding preference stability because the instrument (numeric-observation@1) lacks an independent oracle to validate the stability delta, and the design lacked a explicit control group (non-memory agent) to isolate the causal effect of memory buffers on policy drift.
definition.limitations: The observed 0.25 preference stability delta is currently unvalidated and lacks a comparative baseline to confirm that the observed behavior is significantly different from random stochastic noise in the absence of memory.
definition.next_step: Revise the experimental protocol to include a comparative control (non-memory agent) and use the hidden-relationship@1 instrument to perform a controlled comparison of policy divergence rates.
